program.name: Solanar Graduate Program
program.credential: Graduate Certificate of Completion in Advanced Operational Meteorology
program.prerequisite: Solanar Professional Meteorology Certificate Years I–II or documented equivalent preparation.
program.credential_note: Certificate of completion only; not accredited university credit, government licensure, AMS certification, or a substitute for degree requirements.

mathematics.name: Calculus II
mathematics.use: Integration, series, parametric reasoning and continuous physical-model applications.

mathematics.name: Linear Algebra
mathematics.use: Vectors, matrices, eigenstructure, least squares, SVD, state vectors and data assimilation.

mathematics.name: Differential Equations
mathematics.use: Atmospheric rate equations, systems, stability, numerical methods, oscillations and dynamical models.

mathematics.name: Statistics
mathematics.use: Probability, inference, regression, resampling, verification, calibration and ensemble interpretation.

mathematics.name: Introduction to Proofs
mathematics.use: Formal reasoning, assumptions, proof structure, research writing and defensible derivation.

mathematics.name: Real & Complex Analysis
mathematics.use: Rigorous limits, continuity, convergence and advanced mathematical analysis for research-oriented students.

mathematics.name: Topology & Differential Geometry
mathematics.use: Manifolds, differential forms, curvature and geometric thinking relevant to advanced geophysical fluid dynamics.

tools.name: Solanar Platform
tools.desc: Integrated forecast, hazard and Earth-observation workspace.

tools.name: NAIB Mentor
tools.desc: Socratic defense, mastery repair, research and forecast-reasoning support.

tools.name: Storm Prediction Center
tools.desc: Convective outlooks, mesoscale discussions, watches and analyses.

forms.name: Graduate Case Diagnostic
forms.desc: Full evidence chain: observations, dynamics, remote sensing, guidance, uncertainty and forecast implications.

forms.name: Graduate Mesoanalysis
forms.desc: Boundaries, instability, moisture, forcing, shear, terrain and convective initiation.

forms.name: Radar Interrogation & Warning Evidence Log
forms.desc: Radar sampling, storm structure, trends, signatures, corroboration, uncertainty and decision points.

forms.name: Satellite / Lightning Data Fusion
forms.desc: Multispectral satellite, lightning context, radar integration and trend interpretation.

forms.name: CAM / NWP Evaluation
forms.desc: Convection-allowing model guidance, timing, mode, failure modes, biases and observations.

forms.name: Ensemble & Probability Brief
forms.desc: Spread, clustering, thresholds, calibration, confidence and decision triggers.

forms.name: Warning Decision Science Log
forms.desc: Evidence, alternative hypotheses, human factors, simulated decision and update triggers.

forms.name: Graduate Forecast Shift Log
forms.desc: Situational awareness, priorities, forecast updates, briefings, handoff and verification.

forms.name: Forecast Verification & After-Action Review
forms.desc: Error, bias, hits/misses, calibration, process failures and corrective learning.

forms.name: Research Literature Critique
forms.desc: Question, methods, data, assumptions, evidence, limitations, reproducibility and significance.

forms.name: Reproducible Analysis Record
forms.desc: Dataset provenance, transformations, calculations/code, figures, version notes and replication checks.

forms.name: Capstone Research Proposal
forms.desc: Problem, literature basis, methods, data, hypotheses, ethics, timeline and expected contribution.

forms.name: Capstone Defense Rubric
forms.desc: Scientific depth, methods, reproducibility, operational value, communication and response to questioning.
